reviews.author: Doug Becker
reviews.text: Great experience with these guys! I was amazed how dirty my fence was and how they got it cleaned and how they stay in the whole fence. Everyone was very professional and did a great job!

reviews.author: Alexander Cruz
reviews.text: Thank you so much my fence looks Amazing! Amy helped me walk Thur the process love my new fence stain!!! 5 stars all the way!!!!

reviews.author: armando rojas
reviews.text: Great job, would recommend these guys. Very professional and knowledgeable on what they are doing.

reviews.author: Lyle Harris
reviews.text: Great communication, arrived on time. Job was done in a timely manner. Cleaned up when they finished.  Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Daniel Boardley
reviews.text: Engaged Sterling Fence to stain our 5 year old fence in March of this year and we were really pleased with the result. Quality of work and cleanliness was first class and the price was very reasonable. Would highly recommend if people looking to give their yard a refresh. Before and after photos incl.

reviews.author: Dawson Unruh
reviews.text: Excellent fence staining job! The crew was professional, showed up on time, and paid attention to every detail. The stain was applied evenly and completely transformed the look of our fence. Communication was great throughout the process, and everything was left clean when the job was finished. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Victor Llorens
reviews.text: Great estimate, everything was explained, no hidden fees. Work completed as promised and to my satisfaction. Great communication!

reviews.author: Albert Gonzales
reviews.text: Fence looks almost brand new. Did a great job. Would recommend them highly.

reviews.author: Codie Ballard
reviews.text:
I couldn’t be happier with the work Sterling Fence Staining did on my fence. From the initial consultation to the final walkthrough, the entire process was professional, efficient, and stress-free. The team was punctual, courteous, and paid close attention to every detail.

The quality of the staining exceeded my expectations. My fence looks brand new, and the finish is even, rich, and beautifully applied. They took the time to properly prepare the surface and made sure everything was completed to the highest standard.

What really stood out was their communication and commitment to customer satisfaction. They answered all my questions, kept me informed throughout the project, and truly cared about delivering outstanding results.

If you’re looking for a reliable company that takes pride in their work and delivers exceptional results, I highly recommend Sterling Fence Staining. I will definitely use them again and recommend them to friends and family.

reviews.author: Henry and Kim Contreras
reviews.text:
We are very happy with how the Fence looks and the price with the discount he was offering at the time we booked (5 stars) but very disappointed with the stain on our new patio (0 stars).
We had asked that they cover it so no stain would get on it - that didn’t happen and is now stained. It isn’t terrible but we see it and are not happy. He had his crew come out and power wash over a week later. At first it looked like it may have helped but after it dried completely - the stain was still there.  We called again - haven’t heard or seen them since and honestly at this point don’t think the stain will come out.

reviews.author: Matt Shivers
reviews.text: Awesome crew to work with and very pleased with the result! Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Neal Advani
reviews.text: Very happy with this team. This is the second time they’ve been out. This time was to stain 55’ of new fencing to match our existing fence. They showed up on time, did the job quickly and efficiently and cleaned up. It was like no one had been here. Thanks guys. Look forward to working with you again.

reviews.author: Sonali Joshi
reviews.text:
We recently had our fence stained by Sterling Fence Staining, and the entire experience exceeded our expectations. From the first consultation to the final follow-up, their professionalism, communication, and attention to detail were outstanding.

We selected the beautiful “October Brown” color, and the finished result completely transformed the appearance of our backyard. The stain was applied evenly with great precision, and the quality of workmanship truly shows.

The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and completed the project within the promised timeframe. What impressed us most was how clean and organized everything was after the job was completed. They took the time to clean the entire area thoroughly, leaving our property looking even better than before they arrived.

Sterling Fence Staining also provided excellent follow-up service and kept us informed throughout the process, making everything smooth and stress-free. If you are looking for a company that delivers high-quality fence staining with exceptional customer service, I highly recommend Sterling Fence Staining.

reviews.author: Michael Parr
reviews.text:
My fence has never looked better!
Everyone i had contact with was so professional, kind and so respectful to me and my property.
You won't be disappointed 👍
